title: REALM: Reliable Expertise-Aware Language Model Fine-Tuning from Noisy Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2604.17289v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of large language models relies on human-annotated data, yet annotation pipelines routinely involve multiple crowdworkers of heterogeneous expertise. Standard practice aggregates labels via majority vote or simple averaging, discarding annotator identity and causing the model to absorb the errors of unreliable annotators into its parameters. We propose REALM, which jointly learns the model parameters and a scalar expertise value for each annotator, entirely unsupervised and requiring nothing beyond annotator identity. The key idea is to model each observed label as a mixture between the model's prediction and a uniform random guess, weighted by the annotator's learned expertise. REALM applies to any task with a fixed label set, and extends to multiple tasks via a learned expertise matrix. translated_title: REALM：基于专注意识的可靠语言模型噪声标注微调方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的监督微调依赖于人工标注数据，然而标注流程通常涉及专业水平参差不齐的众多众包标注者。标准做法通过多数投票或简单平均来聚合标签，丢弃了标注者的身份信息，导致模型将不可靠标注者的错误吸收进自身参数中。我们提出REALM，该方法在完全无监督的情况下联合学习模型参数和每个标注者的标量专业能力值，且仅需标注者身份信息。其核心思想是将每个观测到的标签建模为模型预测与均匀随机猜测之间的混合，权重由标注者被学到的专业能力决定。REALM适用于任何具有固定标签集的任务，并可通过学习到的专业能力矩阵扩展至多任务场景。在四个带有真实众包标注的文本分类数据集上，REALM在全部12个配置中均表现最佳。
tldr: REALM提出了一种完全无监督的方法，通过将观测标签建模为模型预测与随机猜测的加权混合，联合学习模型参数和每个标注者的专业能力值，从而实现从噪声标注中可靠地微调语言模型。
en_tdlr: REALM jointly learns model parameters and per-annotator expertise scores in a fully unsupervised manner—by modeling each observed label as a mixture of the model's prediction and a uniform random guess—to reliably fine-tune language models from noisy crowdsourced annotations.
